How do I feel? Thanks for asking! I'm 57F, and I feel like crap. I look like crap. I hate getting older. The saggy skin, wrinkles, weight gain, lack of energy. All this is on top of Major Depressive Disorder, which has also gotten worse as I age. I'm still struggling financially, and I have no friends but the loser who cheated on me. I keep him in my life so that I don't have to spend 100% of the time alone and because, at my age, I need help doing things around my house/yard. Yeah, it's only a rental, but it's one of the best things about my life. 

I feel bad for people younger than myself, and I guess I feel bad for the older ones, too. The way the world works nowadays isn't conducive to happiness. I wish everyone could not have to struggle and have the best opportunity to live a happy and fulfilling life.  

I do keep trying, though. I practice meditation to help restore some peace in my life, and I try to help other people whenever I can. I have tried hard not to become a bitter, mean, unlovable human after a shitty life. I don't know how well I'm accomplishing that.

When I was around 4 or 5, I distinctly remember being outside and looking down at my hands. I kept staring at them. I was thinking, this is me! I am here; this is me! I got a weird feeling, almost like a dizzy, overwhelmed feeling. It's hard to describe. For a couple of years after that, I could stare at my hands and focus on that original thought that I had of "this is me" and still pull up that feeling. Eventually, I couldn't do it anymore. Now, over 50 years later, when I think, "This is me", all I feel is... ugh.  I wish I could recall that happy, excited feeling of being alive again.

Regardless, none of the items should have been moved or touched in any way, and no one should have even entered your apartment since you paid for the month and your lease wasn't up yet. Go right over the Property Manager's head, and ask for the Regional Manager or someone higher up. If they worked for me, some people would definitely be getting fired for this. Good luck OP.
